name: Schwarzkopf Professional BC Bonacure pH 4.5 Color Freeze Shampoo
description: A gentle shampoo formulated to preserve and enhance the vibrancy of color-treated hair. It stabilizes the hair's pH at 4.5, providing optimal care for colored hair. Perfect for color-treated hair, it works to restore a cooler, more neutral tone while preserving the hair’s natural shine.

name: L'Oréal Paris EverPure Sulfate-Free Moisture Shampoo
